entities.name: Quinazoline electrophile
observations: Contains an activated heteroaryl C–Cl bond suitable for SNAr; the pendant 2-chloroethyl ether is retained.
Evidence indicates substitution at the heteroaryl chloride.

entities.name: Fused NH heterocycle
observations: The ring NH acts as the nucleophile in heteroarylation.

entities.name: Quinazoline SNAr heteroarylation
observations: Base-promoted nucleophilic aromatic substitution replaces quinazoline C–Cl with the fused heterocycle nitrogen.
Dipotassium carbonate scavenges HCl; the 2-chloroethyl ether is not assigned as the displaced group.

entities.name: SNAr product candidate
observations: This structure represents replacement of the activated heteroaryl chloride by the second reactant’s nitrogen; tautomeric and ring-numbering variants may be equivalent.
